slides.title: Friday at a glance
slides.body: Golf, F1, soccer, MLB, and college football packed into one day.

slides.title: Golf early
slides.body: DP World Tour, LPGA Solheim Cup, and Champions Tour all start at 12:00 AM ET.

slides.title: F1 + noon soccer
slides.body: F1 at 7:30 AM ET on Apple TV, then European soccer through the afternoon.

slides.title: MLB slate
slides.body: Pirates-Cubs, Rockies-Tigers, Angels-Nationals, and Mets-Yankees all on the board.

slides.title: Night games
slides.body: College football and Gotham FC at Racing Louisville close out the night.
